name: Chili Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Boil together two dozen ripe tomatoes, three small green peppers or a half teaspoonful of cayenne pepper, one onion cut fine, and half a cup of sugar
Strain the whole and set back on the fire
Add one tablespoonful of salt and one teaspoonful each of ginger, allspice, cloves and cinnamon
Remove and seal in glass bottles

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil together two dozen ripe tomatoes, three small green peppers or a half teaspoonful of cayenne pepper, one onion cut fine, and half a cup of sugar
2. Boil until thick
3. Add two cups of vinegar
4. Strain the whole and set back on the fire
5. Add one tablespoonful of salt and one teaspoonful each of ginger, allspice, cloves and cinnamon
6. Boil all five minutes
7. Remove and seal in glass bottles
